# World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO)

> WIPO is the UN agency dedicated to developing balanced intellectual property systems that recognize creator rights while advancing innovation and economic development globally.

WIPO provides comprehensive resources for understanding, protecting, and enforcing intellectual property across patents, trademarks, copyrights, designs, and geographical indications. The organization operates international filing systems, dispute resolution services, and technical assistance programs for IP offices worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Intellectual Property (IP)
- Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT)
- PATENTSCOPE
- Patents
- Trademarks
- Copyright
- Geographical Indications
- Industrial Designs
- IP Protection
- International Patent Classification (IPC)
- IP Dispute Resolution
- WIPO Arbitration and Mediation Center
- Patent Search
- IP Training and Outreach
- UPOV

## Core IP Protection Systems

- [About WIPO](https://www.wipo.int/about-wipo/en): Organization overview of WIPO, UN agency, mission, and leadership
- [What is Intellectual Property?](https://www.wipo.int/about-ip/en): Gateway to WIPO's IP activities covering patents, copyright, trademarks, and industrial designs
- [Patents](https://www.wipo.int/patents/en): Patent protection overview covering PCT system and international patent law
- [Copyright](https://www.wipo.int/copyright/en): Copyright protection covering Berne Convention, creator rights, and collective management
- [Geographical Indications: What do they specify?](https://www.wipo.int/geo_indications/en): Geographical indications overview explaining product origin protection and rights

## IP Filing and Protection Guides

- [How to Protect Inventions through Patents](https://www.wipo.int/patents/en/protection.html): Guide to patent protection, filing, and international patent application processes
- [How to Protect a Trademark?](https://www.wipo.int/trademarks/en/protection.html): Trademark protection guide covering registration and international protection systems
- [How Can I Secure my Industrial Design?](https://www.wipo.int/designs/en/protection.html): Industrial design protection guide using the Hague System and regional offices
- [How Are Geographical Indications Protected?](https://www.wipo.int/geo_indications/en/protection.html): Geographical indications protection through sui generis systems and collective marks

## IP Databases and Search Tools

- [IP Resources](https://www.wipo.int/reference/en): IP databases including PATENTSCOPE, trademark search, and WIPO Knowledge Center
- [Patent and Technology Information](https://www.wipo.int/patents/en/patent-information.html): Search PATENTSCOPE and WIPO INSPIRE for patent data and technology information

## Dispute Resolution and Legal Services

- [Alternative Dispute Resolution](https://www.wipo.int/amc/en): WIPO Arbitration and Mediation Center for IP dispute resolution services

## IP Training and Outreach

- [IP Outreach](https://www.wipo.int/ip-outreach/en/tools): Educational resources and awareness programs for IP training and knowledge sharing

## Governance and Cooperation

- [Decision-making and Negotiating Bodies](https://www.wipo.int/policy/en): Overview of WIPO's policy-making bodies and treaty negotiation procedures
- [Cooperation](https://www.wipo.int/cooperation/en): WIPO's international partnerships and cooperation activities with stakeholders

## Optional

- [IP Office Business Solutions](https://www.wipo.int/global_ip/en/activities/ip_office_business_solutions): Technical assistance for IP offices in developing countries for system participation
- [Paying for Intellectual Property (IP) Application Fees and Services with WIPO or UPOV](https://www.wipo.int/finance/en): Payment methods and fee instructions for IP applications through WIPO Pay
